scope: Independent source, regression-subsumption and authority review of ReviewSession screenshot serialization and ambiguous-capture containment against PRD 13.4/JUDGE-CAP-001.
observations: Every screenshot target uses one per-session queue, acquired before its initial snapshot and held through all tiles, restoration and artifact registration. Queued inputs are cloned and open-state authority is checked again on execution.

Before and after platform pixel capture, the existing exact execution/thread/revision/turn/layer/selection/action/navigation binding checks remain. Concurrent Graph/Esc presentation changes reject evidence instead of relabeling pixels.

Ambiguous capture-mutating renderer timeouts and failed restoration invalidate subsequent screenshot work. A timed-out underlying command may complete late, but queued and later requests are refused before creating another capture.

Ordinary failed platform captures and rejected unknown targets do not poison a successfully restored session. Invalid requests cannot restore another request's target. A preceding capture failure and cleanup failure are both preserved through AggregateError.
Server-enforced read-only constructor authority, visible-control interaction/history boundaries, scoped screenshot evidence and graph acceptance behavior are unchanged.

testSubsumption.replacedTest: does not restore an element capture owned by an overlapping request
testSubsumption.replacementTest: binds overlapping full-element captures to their own target pixels
testSubsumption.reason: The old fixture acquired capture ownership synchronously and could not reproduce the production pre-animation-frame race. The replacement models that race and verifies every persisted tile byte against its declared node-detail, graph or viewport target. Serialization eliminates overlapping ownership; separate queued failure, unknown-target, late-timeout, restoration-failure and closed-window cases retain the old cleanup and authority failure boundaries. Existing Graph/Esc tests remain.

independentVerification.command: npx vitest run test/review-session.test.mjs test/judge-screenshot-loader.test.mjs test/review-workspace-readiness.test.mjs packages/eval-runner/test/simulated-user-evidence-validator.test.ts

limits: This scoped review and warm verification do not claim completion of the new full repository, compiled-runtime or real-browser proofs; the main agent records those separately.
This change does not repair or revalidate already saved mismatched screenshots. Prior pilot and failed-attempt artifacts remain immutable evidence.
No paid inference was executed by this reviewer. Provider-capacity failure, candidate acceptance, screenshot-grounded judge coverage and comparative quality remain separate outcomes.
invalidation: Any change to the reviewed source or tests invalidates this source assertion. Review is non-certifying without a PR.
